press_references.value: Dapper Labs and Coinbase Collab to Foster Web3 Ecosystem in Vancouver

partnership_announcements.description: Dapper Labs and Coinbase are collaborating to foster the Web3 ecosystem in Vancouver. The collaboration is part of Coinbase's "Stand with Crypto" campaign, which aims to promote regulatory clarity and the adoption of cryptocurrency in Canada. The event will be held at Dapper Labs' office and will feature speakers including Coinbase Canada CEO Lucas Matheson and Dapper Labs CEO Roham Gharegozlou. The initiative seeks to unite Web3 builders and crypto advocates, support related businesses, and cultivate a blockchain ecosystem in Canada.

research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Dapper Labs is researching systems for locking non-fungible token transfers for collection building, creating, managing, and displaying 3D digital collectibles, including limited edition and serialized forms, and user-owned collections. Efforts also include delayed reveal of 3D digital collectibles, interactive displays, and managing access to online digital collectibles based on user eligibility. These areas reflect a focus on digital collectible management, user interaction, and secure access.
